name: break
title: Take it apart with Break the Wall
description: Explain a topic and take the explanation apart with Break the Wall: you write the disassembly, the app checks and saves it. With no topic, take apart the last long answer, or say what to explain when asked.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: The question or topic to explain. Leave it empty to take apart the last long answer of the conversation, or to be asked.
